Confirmed—#318 is merged. The two digest corrections weren’t included, so [CI on `main` now fails](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/actions/runs/38237671813) on the same checksum mismatch.

A small follow-up updating `FAIR-CONFIG.md` and `UPSTREAM.md` is still needed.
What do you recommend for `.github/dependabot.yml`?
I’ll check the dependency files and GitHub Actions, then recommend a configuration that fits this repo.

I’d enable **weekly Go and GitHub Actions updates**, and keep **benchmark Python dependencies security-only** until checksum maintenance is automated.

- Group minor and patch updates to reduce PR noise.
- Leave major updates and tree-sitter updates separate for focused review.
- Keep the benchmark environment stable between deliberate refreshes.

Suggested `.github/dependabot.yml`:

```yaml
version: 2

updates:
  - package-ecosystem: gomod
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
    open-pull-requests-limit: 3
    groups:
      go-minor-and-patch:
        patterns: ["*"]
        exclude-patterns:
          - github.com/smacker/go-tree-sitter
        update-types: [minor, patch]
    commit-message:
      prefix: chore
      include: scope

  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
    open-pull-requests-limit: 3
    groups:
      actions-minor-and-patch:
        patterns: ["*"]
        update-types: [minor, patch]
    commit-message:
      prefix: chore
      include: scope

  - package-ecosystem: pip
    directory: /bench/memory
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    # Disable routine version PRs; retain security updates.
    open-pull-requests-limit: 0
    commit-message:
      prefix: chore
      include: scope
```

Dependencies outside the minor/patch groups remain eligible for individual PRs. Setting the Python PR limit to zero preserves security updates. [GitHub’s configuration reference](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference)

Python security PRs will still need the `FAIR-CONFIG.md` and `UPSTREAM.md` digests refreshed—the configuration alone won’t prevent another #318 checksum failure.
